subject.title: fix(tui): prevent compact-terminal approval stress regressions

question: Should this protected maintainer-labelled TUI test reliability change proceed once maintainers accept the supplied runtime-proof level or request an inspectable compact-terminal artifact?
rationale: The patch is narrowly scoped and has no supported code-level defect, but the protected label requires explicit maintainer handling and the externally visible proof cannot be independently inspected from the PR text.

options.title: Request compact-terminal artifact
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, recording, or live-output artifact that shows the approval prompt wraps and resolves at 72x20.

options.title: Accept existing validation
options.body: Proceed based on the reported real PTY and Gateway runs plus the passing repository checks if maintainers consider that evidence sufficient for this test-only change.

recommendation.title: Request compact-terminal artifact
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript, recording, or live-output artifact that shows the approval prompt wraps and resolves at 72x20.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete authored the focused TUI harness change and can most directly provide the claimed runtime evidence or clarify its provenance.
